hypothesis: At N256, assign eight adjacent elements to each lane, use aligned 16B I/O and pack register-neighbor INT4 values without eight q shuffles; investigate lower memory/packing instruction overhead while preserving all eight butterfly stages.

correctness.dao_offset_reference: Pinned Dao csrc/fast_hadamard_transform_common.h load_input uses unguarded16B vector loads for FP16/BF16. During2B-offset correctness checks only, Dao receives an aligned bit-identical clone, verified against original input. Both experiment layouts receive the actual offset tensor. Performance inputs are aligned and identical for all methods; cloning is never timed.
per_configuration: all elements original/new transform bitwise equal
same input compared to real Dao CUDA with original strict tolerance
original/new fused packed and scales bitwise equal
each fused equals same-layout transform then standalone quantization
CPU float32 maxabs/7 and divided RNE INT4 for every actual transformed row
input and guard storage bitwise unchanged
correctness.scale: same float32 value for all methods:1 or1/16
correctness.non_default_stream: All24 configurations, both pointer offsets, normal seed2026; create/fill input and call transform/fused/quantization under the non-default stream, then synchronize before CPU comparison.
correctness.standalone_quantization_ties: M17,N256, both dtypes and both input pointer offsets; repeat exactly representable values [-7,-6.5,-5.5,-4.5,-3.5,-2.5,-1.5,-0.5,0,0.5,1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5,5.5,6.5,7]. Compare both layouts to independent CPU packed/scales, and preserve input guards.
correctness.output_alignment_boundary: Public allocating adapter returns aligned outputs; input offset fallback is exercised. Kernel independently guards output16B/packed4B alignment, but no claim of a user-supplied misaligned output API is made.
correctness.failure_policy: Stop before timing on any failed check; preserve report, first differing value/bits and CPU witness. No tolerance or expected-value edits.

timing.input: aligned contiguous, normal seed2026; exactly same input per mode/method/configuration
timing.outputs: 64 separate retained output tuples per private Graph; every component pointer distinct within and across graphs; bitwise equal to eager before and after timing
timing.method_order: Cyclic offset(run_index-1+configuration_index+group) modulo method count; initial warmup and capture use group0 order. Mode order alternates by configuration_index+run_index.
timing.samples: Keep all raw CUDA event intervals in ms, derive per-call ms/us, median5 groups per independent process. Graph includes captured GPU work and amortized replay scheduling, not standalone kernel latency. No eager performance or cross-GPU/earlier-study denominators.

decision.fixed_matrix: Run all24 configurations in all3 processes after correctness. No follow-on search domain or thread search.
decision.stable_improvement: A candidate comparison needs >=5% time reduction against same-run original in each of3 processes to count as a stable performance improvement.
decision.regressions: Preserve every loss and report all configurations with >3% regression in any process, separately by transform/fused. Any range recommendation must include its neighboring and negative cases; no automatic production dispatch.
decision.dao: Only transform compares with Dao. M17N256 gap closes only if new median<=Dao in all3 processes. <=1% differences are near-ties, not durable wins.
decision.scope: Acceptance requires exact numerical contract first. A winning configuration does not establish a global replacement or proof of optimality.

resource_policy: Await coordinator GPU window; use existing environment and a dedicated module/build/cache. Sequential workers require two0% NVML samples2s apart before each, wait at most60s. Record all processes/snapshots; never stop unknown PIDs or claim exclusive tenancy from utilization alone. No dependency upgrades.
